hints.title: Read the requirement
hints.body: The method receives one value and must return the same value.

hints.title: No transformation
hints.body: There is no arithmetic or formatting step. Return the parameter.

hints.title: The body is one line
hints.body: Use a return statement with the parameter name. Do not print it.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
return value
```

Translate that into the method body.
